name: Ziphah
overview: Ziphah is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Jehallelel. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no additional notes or distinguishing attributes about him. His mention situates him within the broader lineage of Judah, emphasizing his place in the biblical genealogical record.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Ziphah' appears as a proper name in Scripture without any given meaning or divine attribution. It is simply recorded as the name of this individual in 1 Chronicles 4:16, offering no further linguistic or theological insight.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ziphah as the son of Jehallelel, establishing a direct father-son relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented for Ziphah beyond this lineage.
scriptureSignificance: Ziphah's significance lies primarily in his inclusion in the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah, as noted in 1 Chronicles 4:16. This inclusion underscores the importance of genealogies in tracing the heritage and covenantal promises fulfilled through Judah's lineage. While Ziphah himself does not have a recorded narrative or role, his mention contributes to the biblical emphasis on God's faithfulness in preserving His people through successive generations.
